description: Shift register with eight stages, A to H, working as one eight-stage register or as two independent four-stage ones

inputs.text: The voltage sampled into stage A each time the shift input feeding stages A to D receives a rising edge
A rising edge moves the values at stages A to D along by one and samples the input feeding them into stage A
The voltage sampled into stage E on each shift of stages E to H; with nothing patched it takes whatever stage D is holding, which makes the module one eight-stage register
A rising edge moves the values at stages E to H along by one and samples their input into stage E; with nothing patched it follows the shift input feeding stages A to D

outputs.text: Carries the voltage held at that stage

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
